slug: 2025-10-23 Congo relaunches NIU biometric unique-ID card production

systems.owner: Ministère des Finances (instituted for the tax directorate, DGID)
systems.tiers: national; issued to every foreign resident and Congolese citizen from age 6 with iris and fingerprint capture, valid ten years; card production relaunched from September 2025

note: On the tax number that has become a general identity credential. Nothing on civil registration.
